title: Sanctuary mod manifest (mod.json)
description: Describes a mod folder under engine\SanctuaryMods. See docs/writing-mods.md.

id.description: How the lobby names the mod to other players. Prefix it with your own name so it never collides with someone else's.

name.description: Shown on the Mods page and in the lobby.

version.description: Shown to players; the lobby compares contents, not this.

description.description: A sentence or two, shown on the Mods page.

kind.description: ui: changes only your own screen, you switch it on and off. gameplay: changes the match; the lobby host picks it and every player needs an identical copy.

luaRoot.description: The folder, inside the mod, that mirrors the game's LJ\lua. Default "lua".

url.description: Where to get the mod. Shown to players who are missing it.

requires.description: Ids of gameplay mods that must be picked alongside this one.

apiVersion.description: The Mod API major version the mod was written for.

gameVersion.description: The game version the mod was made and tested for ("0.0.1.20"), or a prefix of it ("0.0.1"). On any other version the Mods page says so; the mod still loads.

hostScript.description: A Lua file of the mod's, relative to its lua folder ("alice/norush/host.lua"), imported in the host's simulation when the mod is picked. The place for match rules; see Import("modapi/events.lua").Events.

clientScript.description: A Lua file of the mod's, relative to its lua folder, imported in every player's client (and replays) when the mod is picked. For what players see.

options.description: Settings the lobby host picks for a gameplay mod. Lua reads them with Import("modoptions/<id>.lua").Options.

key.description: The name Lua and C# read the value by. A Lua name: letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit, not a Lua keyword.

label.description: Shown in the lobby. Default: the key.

type.description: toggle: on or off. choice: one of a list. number: a number, optionally in a range and on a step.

default.description: A toggle's true or false, a choice's value, or a number. Missing: off, the first choice, or the lowest number.

choices.description: For a choice: values, or { value, label } pairs.

min.description: For a number: the lowest value.

max.description: For a number: the highest value. With min, the lobby shows a slider.

step.description: For a number: values snap to min plus a whole number of steps.

factions.description: Factions the mod adds to the lobby's faction dropdown while the host has it picked. The Mod API numbers them after the game's three, in pick order, and writes them into FactionsData; no C# needed.

key.description: The mod's own name for the faction. Default: the tag in small letters.

name.description: Shown in the lobby, and FactionsData's name.

tag.description: The faction tag every unit of the faction carries in its tags list (Tags.DYCOM). Not EDA, CHOSEN or GUARD.

unitPrefix.description: The two letters the faction's unit ids start with ("ud"). Not ue, uc or ug.

icon.description: A PNG in the mod folder shown beside the name in the lobby ("icons/dycom.png"), 64x64 or so.

looksLike.description: Whose shields, build beams, factory platforms and adjacency effects the faction's units borrow.

commander.description: The starting unit's template id, when the faction has one commander.

commanders.description: Commanders to pick from, each its own entry in the dropdown ("Dycom", "Dycom (Mech)"). The first is the default.

name.description: Shown in the dropdown after the faction's name.

ai.description: The AI the faction's AI armies play: a folder under the mod's lua folder laid out like AI/mods/AI-Sanctuary-Rush, or false/absent for the stock AI.

land.description: Let the AI use land units. Default true.

air.description: Let the AI use air units. Default true.

naval.description: Let the AI use naval units. Default false.
